children: “We are pleased to report the results for our fiscal year end 2026, including increasing earnings per share by 22%, increasing our transaction deposit balances by 4.6%, and growing our active loan segments by 7.9% along with seeing significant improvements in asset quality measures. Specifically, both non-performing assets and delinquencies decreased by 37% since the June 30th quarter end. Asset quality measures improved primarily through the resolution of a large previously classified loan during the quarter resulting in a $36 million charge-off. Our balance sheet strength and resiliency were demonstrated this quarter, allowing us to handle the classified loan, while still delivering meaningful improvement in earnings to shareholders. In spite of the recent surge in interest rates to their highest level in the last twenty years, with the 10 year bond at levels above 5.20%, WaFd is well positioned to benefit from rising rates as our assets are expected to reprice more quickly than our liabilities resulting in expansion of our margin over the short term.”
President and CEO of WaFd Bank

) (the “Company”), parent company of WaFd Bank (the “Bank”), today announced quarterly earnings of $59,991,000, a decrease of 9% compared to the quarter ended June 30, 2026. After the effect of dividends on preferred stock, net income available for common shareholders was $0.76 per diluted share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 compared to $0.84 the prior quarter.

Annual earnings were $255,865,000 for fiscal year ended September 30, 2026, an increase of 13% from earnings of $226,068,000 for the year ended September 30, 2025. After the effect of dividends on preferred stock, net income available for common shareholders was $3.21 per diluted share for the year ended September 30, 2026, compared to $2.63 per diluted share for the year ended September 30, 2025, a $0.58 or 22% increase in fully diluted earnings per common share.

Total assets increased to $27.2 billion as of September 30, 2026, compared to $26.7 billion at September 30, 2025, primarily due to the purchase of investment securities during the period. Investment securities increased by $0.8 billion, or 18.1% in the year ended September 30, 2026, a result of the $1.4 billion in purchases, primarily discount-priced 30-year mortgage backed securities at an expected yield to maturity of 5%. Net loans decreased $1.0 billion to $19.0 billion as a result of loan sale related activity. The Company sold $543 million of single-family residential loans during the September quarter and has entered into an agreement to sell $429 million of multifamily loans in the first quarter of fiscal 2027. These multifamily loans have been reclassified as Held for Sale as of September 30, 2026. We expect to realize a net gain of approximately $7 million when the sale is finalized.

Customer deposits totaled $21.3 billion as of September 30, 2026, compared to $21.4 billion at September 30, 2025. The effective weighted average interest rate, including non-interest bearing deposits, was 2.49% as of September 30, 2026, compared to 2.60% at September 30, 2025. Transaction accounts increased by $569 million or 4.6% during the period, while time deposits decreased $686 million or 7.5%. As of September 30, 2026, 60.4% of the Company’s deposits were transaction accounts, a slight increase from 57.4% at September 30, 2025. Core deposits, defined as all transaction accounts and time deposits less than $250,000, totaled 81.8% of deposits at September 30, 2026, up from 77.9% on September 30, 2025. Deposits that are uninsured or not collateralized were 25.7% of total deposits as of September 30, 2026, a small increase from 24.7% as of September 30, 2025.

Borrowings totaled $2.5 billion as of September 30, 2026, up from $1.8 billion at September 30, 2025. The effective weighted average interest rate of borrowings was 3.0% as of September 30, 2026, compared to 2.5% at September 30, 2025.

Loan originations for active loan types totaled $5.5 billion for fiscal year 2026, compared to $4.0 billion of originations in fiscal year 2025. Offsetting loan originations in each year were loan repayments of $3.9 billion and $5.1 billion, respectively. Active loan types include the commercial segment and the consumer portfolio. Inactive loan types include all consumer residential portfolios. These loan types had repayments of $1.1 billion during fiscal 2026. Commercial loans represented 95% of all loan originations during fiscal 2026 and consumer loans accounted for the remaining 5%. The period end interest yield on the loan portfolio was 5.44% as of September 30, 2026, an increase from 5.38% as of September 30, 2025.

Tangible common equity per share is a key metric for our management team. For the year ended September 30, 2026, tangible common equity per share grew from $29.38 as of September 30, 2025 to $30.51 at September 30, 2026. This metric is a non-GAAP Financial Measure. See page 9 for additional information on our use of non-GAAP Financial Measures. During the year, the Company repurchased 4,703,844 shares of common stock at a weighted average price of $31.00. Our share repurchase plan currently has an authorization of 7,992,669 shares.

Considering the shifting economic and monetary environment, further impacted by on-going global developments, credit quality continues to be monitored closely. Asset quality metrics improved as of September 30, 2026, primarily a result of a $53 million loan relationship being resolved during the quarter resulting in a $36 million charge-off. Non-performing assets decreased to $86 million, or 0.32% of total assets, from $136 million, or 0.49%, at June 30, 2026 and from $143 million, or 0.54%, at September 30, 2025. Non-accrual loans decreased by $52 million, or 40%, compared to June 30 2026 and by $53 million, or 40.95%, since September 30, 2025. Delinquent loans decreased to 0.50% of total loans at September 30, 2026, compared to 0.75% at June 30, 2026 and 0.60% at September 30, 2025.

The allowance for credit losses (including the reserve for unfunded commitments) totaled $215 million as of September 30, 2026, and was 1.04% of gross loans outstanding, as compared to 1.08% and 1.04% of gross loans outstanding as of June 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025, respectively. The decrease compared to the prior quarter was the result of improved outlook on credit quality combined with a reduction in adversely classified loans. Net charge-offs were $39.2 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $1.6 million the prior quarter. Net charge-offs were $45.1 million for fiscal year 2026, compared to $11.8 million for fiscal 2025.

Net interest income was $182.4 million for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026, a small increase of $1 million or 0.6% from the prior quarter. This minor change was the result of a flat net interest margin. Net interest margin was 2.81% in the fourth fiscal quarter 2026, the same as the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

Total non-interest income was $38.1 million for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 compared to $24.2 million the prior quarter. The increase was primarily driven by a $16.4 million gain on the sale of single family loans during the quarter. This gain was partially offset by the quarter-over-quarter reduction in non-interest income attributable to the $3 million gain on the sale of bank real estate recognized in the third quarter.

Total non-interest expense was $121.5 million for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026, an increase of $11.2 million, or 10.1%, from the prior quarter. This was the result of continued investments in our people and technologies combined with $6 million in merger related costs incurred during the fourth quarter. The Company’s efficiency ratio increased in the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 to 55.12%, compared to 53.69% in the prior quarter as a result of the increase in expenses related to the merger.

The Company recorded a $20.0 million provision for credit losses for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 compared to a provision of $11.0 million the prior quarter. The provision for loan losses for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 was the result of growth in the active loan portfolio and increased charge-offs during the quarter.

Income tax expense totaled $17.1 million for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026, as compared to $18.2 million for the prior quarter. The effective tax rate for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was 22.17%, compared to 21.60% for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Company’s effective tax rate may vary from the statutory rate mainly due to state taxes, tax-exempt income and tax-credit investments.
WaFd Bank is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, and has 210 branches in nine western states. To find out more about WaFd Bank, please visit our website
